findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity as primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; the reward view is the endpoint pointcloud with a detached FLOWR endpoint VJP, so no affinity-head derivative or extra model forward is available as evidence.

Observed score clocks span 0.0 to 0.49 with a learning window of [0.0,0.5] and curve support [0.0,0.49]; recorded affinities were removed and an equal score prior applies, so no decoded terminal affinity labels exist in the supplied evidence.

Continuous contrast functions are supplied only as observed-node linear interpolations over the observed support with extrapolation disallowed; no polynomial fit was accepted for the read landmark features, so time-conditioned rules cannot be validated beyond the observed nodes.

The read landmark coordinate contrasts show sign reversals and strong sign conflicts within the observed window (e.g. landmark_00_local_dx has 6 sign changes and 9 strong sign conflicts; landmark_00_local_dz has 10 sign changes and 7 strong sign conflicts), so a constant-direction coordinate rule is not supported by these features.

First-rate and last-rate z values for the read landmark features are large and opposite in sign (e.g. landmark_00_local_dy first_rate_z negative and last_rate_z positive), indicating rate changes across the observed window rather than a stationary contrast; these are coordinate contrast diagnostics, not trajectory velocity forces or absolute reward targets.

hypotheses.direction: time-conditioned rather than constant coordinate contrast
hypotheses.falsifier: a constant rule matching the observed-node contrasts with no sign changes or rate reversals in independent batches
hypotheses.observable: observed-node contrast sign and rate of the named landmark features across score times 0.0-0.49
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned coordinate contrast rule over the observed score window may better describe the read landmark features than a constant rule, because the observed-node contrasts change sign and rate within the window.

hypotheses.direction: withhold a directional coordinate rule for these features
hypotheses.falsifier: independent-batch agreement with a consistent sign and no strong sign conflicts
hypotheses.statement: The read landmark coordinate contrasts are not reproducible as a single direction because strong sign conflicts and multiple sign changes appear within the observed window.

limitations: No decoded terminal affinity labels are supplied; recorded affinities were removed and an equal score prior applies, so last-record or survival credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.

Only the first page of continuous_trends was read; the remaining rows and the branch_adjusted, endpoint_effects, increment_effects, joint_diagnostics, regional_effects, survival_effects and turnover_accounting tables were not inspected in this response.
No joint-pose, covariance or intact-conformation diagnostics were read, so no claim is made about whether a region adds information beyond common motion.
No parent-child increment or turnover residual evidence was read, so within-path change versus changing cohort composition is not assessed.
The supplied contrasts are coordinate diagnostics; they are not physical interaction energies, neural-module causation, or absolute reward targets.
